definitions.H_12: {1||c: exists r such that x=r||c is a canonical length-24 UNSAT word}
definitions.canonical_raw_length: 8 + |gamma(v)| + |gamma(m)| + 3m(1+bit_length(v)); append one zero iff raw length is odd
definitions.swapped_reduction: retain x=r||c -> (2^12+c,r) for the transposed graph

falsifiers: a canonical UNSAT encoding of length below 24
a canonical UNSAT length-24 encoding with (v,m) other than (1,2)
a v=1 payload literal whose variable-code bit is 0
a canonical prefix whose MAGIC bit 4 is not 0
a label lying in both H_12 and P_13
any hidden change to the C048 swapped reduction
length_parity_padding_obligations: prove raw length lower bound 24 and equality conditions
show equality case raw length is already even, so no padding bit is used
do not assume later lengths share the k=12 payload alignment
non_guarantees: candidate is not yet proved or evaluated
no downstream target, cover, circuit lower bound, novelty, or P-versus-NP result

selected_discriminator.justification: This is the smallest k at which H_k can be nonempty: a canonical UNSAT 3CNF needs at least two clauses, and the exact encoding lower bound is 8+1+3+12=24=2k bits.

shared_bit_obligation: Compare zero-indexed bit 4: H_12 fixes it to the variable-code bit 1, while P_13 fixes it to MAGIC[4]=0.

statement.conclusion: H_12 intersection P_13 is empty by the fixed bit-4 mismatch.
statement.minimality: H_k is empty for k<12 because every canonical UNSAT 3CNF needs m>=2 and every such encoding has even length at least 24.
statement.parameter_forcing: Any canonical UNSAT word of length 24 attains every lower bound, hence v=1, m=2, |gamma(v)|=1, |gamma(m)|=3, and the 12-bit header MAGIC||1||010 occupies exactly the first half.
statement.prefix_pattern: Every p in P_13 begins with MAGIC=11100101, so zero-indexed bit 4 of p is 0.
statement.quantifier: at the first semantically admissible parent half-length k=12
statement.scope_consequence: The literal-transpose repair fails at the first k where a canonical UNSAT suffix row can exist; this does not decide overlap at k>12.
statement.suffix_pattern: The suffix c is the complete 12-bit payload of six v=1 literals. Each literal is sign||1, so h=1||c has bit 4 equal to 1 (indeed every even-indexed bit of h is 1).

swapped_reduction_preservation: No coordinate, decoder, split, or reduction change is proposed; x=r||c continues to map to (2^12+c,r) exactly as C048 requires.
unsat_proof_obligation: For minimality, prove a one-clause CNF is satisfiable. For nonvacuity of the first admissible syntax, an eventual certificate may exhibit the v=1,m=2 formula (z∨z∨z) AND (not z∨not z∨not z); the candidate conclusion itself uses only the conditional form for every canonical UNSAT length-24 word.
